jobs: A single small medieval Persian mining camp building for an isometric strategy game, in the hand-painted semi-realistic style of Age of Empires 2 building sprites. True 2:1 isometric view, seen corner-on from above, lit from the upper left. Warm sand-coloured fired brick and smooth plaster, one pointed arch, a strip of turquoise and cobalt glazed tile, a flat roof behind a low crenellated parapet and one small turquoise-tiled dome. An open-sided shed with an ore cart, a pile of grey stone and glinting gold ore, picks and baskets. COMPACT: one small square building, no yard, no walls around it, nothing spreading beyond the building itself. A small pure magenta #FF00FF awning; nothing else magenta or pink. Plain pure white background, no ground, no grass, no cast shadow on the background, no people, no text.

A single South Indian Chola archery range building for an isometric strategy game, in the hand-painted semi-realistic style of Age of Empires 2 building sprites. True 2:1 isometric view, seen corner-on from above, lit from the upper left. Carved grey granite pillars on a low stepped plinth, a sloping roof of red clay tiles with carved wooden brackets, temple-style ornament, garlands and brass lamps. A covered stand for the archers along one side and three straw targets on posts in a small yard, the whole thing one compact square block no wider than the roofed building: no outer walls, no extra courtyard, nothing spreading beyond it. Pure magenta #FF00FF cloth banners; nothing else magenta or pink. Plain pure white background, no ground, no grass, no cast shadow on the background, no people, no text.
